ReportItem.pluginName: Apache Tomcat AJP Ghostcat File Read/Include
ReportItem.synopsis: The Apache Tomcat AJP connector is affected by a file read/include vulnerability.
ReportItem.description: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read web application files from the Tomcat server.
ReportItem.solution: Upgrade Apache Tomcat to version 9.0.31 or later.

ReportItem.pluginName: SSL/TLS: Server Supports Weak Cipher Suites
ReportItem.synopsis: The remote host supports weak cipher suites.
ReportItem.description: The SSL/TLS server is configured to support weak cipher suites.
ReportItem.solution: Configure the server to disable weak cipher suites.

ReportItem.synopsis: The remote host is using a version of GnuTLS that is affected by a key extraction vulnerability.
ReportItem.description: The version of GnuTLS installed on the remote host is affected by a vulnerability that allows RSA key extraction.
ReportItem.solution: Update GnuTLS to the latest version.

ReportItem.synopsis: The SSH server supports CBC mode ciphers.
ReportItem.description: The remote SSH server is configured to support CBC mode cipher suites which may be vulnerable.
ReportItem.solution: Configure SSH to disable CBC mode ciphers.

ReportItem.synopsis: The MySQL server has a weak password configured.
ReportItem.description: The remote MySQL server is using a weak password that can be easily brute-forced.
ReportItem.solution: Set a strong password for the MySQL root account.
